STRUCTURING.label: Structuring / smurfing (deposits)
STRUCTURING.description: Deposits engineered in amounts just below the reporting threshold to avoid detection.

SMURFING.label: Smurfing (multiple originators)
SMURFING.description: Many small deposits from many distinct originators concentrated into one account.

RAPID_MOVEMENT.label: Rapid movement of funds
RAPID_MOVEMENT.description: A large share of credited value is moved out again within a short window, consistent with pass-through / layering.

CIRCULAR_FLOW.label: Circular flow / round-tripping
CIRCULAR_FLOW.description: Funds move through a cycle of accounts and return to the origin with only a small reduction in value.

HIGH_VELOCITY.label: High-velocity burst activity
HIGH_VELOCITY.description: Transaction count in a short window far exceeds the account's established baseline.

DORMANT_REACTIVATION.label: Dormant account reactivation
DORMANT_REACTIVATION.description: An account with no activity for an extended period suddenly shows a burst of high-value transactions.

CASH_INTENSIVE.label: Cash-intensive activity
CASH_INTENSIVE.description: A disproportionate share of the account's transaction volume is conducted in cash relative to its profile.

CROSS_BORDER_RISK.label: Cross-border jurisdiction exposure
CROSS_BORDER_RISK.description: The account transacted with a counterparty located in a jurisdiction flagged as high or elevated risk.

ROUND_AMOUNTS.label: Round-amount transaction pattern
ROUND_AMOUNTS.description: An unusually high share of transactions are in round, even amounts, inconsistent with ordinary commercial activity.

PROFILE_DEVIATION.label: Deviation from declared profile
PROFILE_DEVIATION.description: Observed transaction volume substantially exceeds the volume the customer declared at onboarding.

ML_ANOMALY.label: Statistical anomaly (unsupervised model)
ML_ANOMALY.description: The account's behavioural profile was flagged as anomalous by the unsupervised detection ensemble, independent of any single deterministic rule.
